title: A summer photography workshop
situation: You are interested in the course in the advertisement below. You would like to take part in it this summer, but you need more information. Write an e-mail to Mr Moore.
situationHu: Egy brightoni nyári fotós tanfolyam érdekel; írj hivatalos e-mailt a szervezőnek, és kérj további információt.
stimulus:
SUMMER PHOTOGRAPHY WORKSHOP
Seaside Arts Centre, Brighton, 4–15 August
For young people aged 15–19
Learn to take great photos with your camera or your phone!
For more information, please contact Mr David Moore, Course Organiser.

points.text: say how you found out about the course and why you are interested in it
ask about the timetable of the course
ask whether the centre can help with accommodation

usefulPhrases.en: I am writing to ask for information about your summer photography workshop.
usefulPhrases.hu: A nyári fotós tanfolyamukkal kapcsolatban szeretnék érdeklődni.

usefulPhrases.en: I have been interested in photography for … years.
I would like to improve my skills.
Could you please tell me how many hours a day the classes are?
usefulPhrases.hu: Megírná, kérem, hány órásak naponta a foglalkozások?

usefulPhrases.en: I would also like to know whether …
Thank you in advance for your help.

checklistExtra: A kérdéseimet udvarias, közvetett formában tettem fel (Could you tell me …? I would like to know …)?
